title: Curator Fee Type
description: How the curator's margin is structured. Aligned with IAB Deals API v1.0 fee transparency fields.

enumDescriptions.percentage: Curator takes a percentage of the buyer's bid (e.g., 20% of $5.00 CPM = $1.00 curator fee, $4.00 to publisher auction)
enumDescriptions.flat_cpm: Curator charges a fixed CPM on top of media cost (e.g., $0.50 flat fee per thousand impressions regardless of bid amount)
